feed.title: NPR Topics: Health
feed.subtitle: Comprehensive health news from NPR. Follow for updates on medical research, wellness trends, public health policy, patient care and healthcare systems.

entry.title: Public health expert reacts to latest measles milestone
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Dr. Ashish Jha, senior fellow at Harvard's Belfer Center and former White House coronavirus czar, about the news that the U.S. has lost its measles elimination status.

entry.title: U.S. officially loses its measles elimination status
entry.summary: The Pan American Health Organization announced that measles is no longer considered eliminated in the U.S. It's classified as endemic now because a strain has lingered in the U.S. for over a year.

entry.title: I'm a human doctor with human intelligence. But I sure do like my AI notetaker
entry.summary: Has your doctor asked whether they can use artificial intelligence to take notes during an exam? It's very popular, and here's how to think through the pros and the cons of the new technology.

entry.title: More people are getting the flu. Should you get a flu shot before you travel?
entry.summary: Thanksgiving is just around the corner, just as millions of Americans are expected to travel for the holidays. Another thing that's upon us? Cold and flu season.

entry.title: Health organization to announce that the U.S. has lost its measles elimination status
entry.summary: The Pan American Health Organization is expected to announce that measles is no longer eliminated in the U.S. Record cases, lower vaccination rates and uncontained outbreaks led to the resurgence.

entry.title: Why sleep matters when it comes to weight gain and loss
entry.summary: Sleep can have a powerful impact on weight. Research shows it can affect appetite. There is also a two-way relationship between sleep quality and diet.

entry.title: What's the real cost of fast fashion? Ask the people making your jeans
entry.summary: Sydney Sweeney has great jeans, American Eagle Outfitters tells us. But who made them? And what are working conditions like in the garment factories of Pakistan and Bangladesh?

entry.title: Laws limiting coal miners' exposure to toxic dust are in danger of being rolled back
entry.summary: Coal miners who are exposed to silica dust are at a higher risk of black lung disease. Despite decades of advocacy, new efforts to regulate the toxic dust are under threat.

entry.title: A new generation of disability rights activists carry on Judy Heumann's legacy
entry.summary: The film Being Heumann tells the lesser-known story of the mother of the disability rights movement. A new generation of activists share how they "carry the torch" today.

entry.title: US has lost measles elimination status, global health authorities say
entry.summary: The U.S. has lost its status as a country where measles is eliminated, according to researchers with direct knowledge of the deliberations at the Pan American Health Organization.
